responsibility: Implements MSP430 ABI classification by passing aggregates larger than 32 bits indirectly and widening other arguments and returns to 16 bits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/msp430.rs`, this MSP430 file applies the calling convention for functions, deciding when larger aggregates go by reference and widening values to 16 bits, rather than enumerating inline-assembly registers and forbidden special registers.
